mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_excel_upload_batch (file_name, total_rows, inserted_count, uploaded_at) VALUES (#{fileName}, #{totalRows}, #{insertedCount}, NOW())

INSERT INTO tb_excel_upload_row (batch_id, row_no, sale_date, gasoline_in_liter, gasoline_sale_liter, gasoline_diff_liter, gasoline_selling_price, gasoline_buy_price, diesel_in_liter, diesel_sale_liter, diesel_diff_liter, diesel_selling_price, diesel_buy_price, adj_gasoline_physical_liter, adj_gasoline_diff_liter, adj_diesel_physical_liter, adj_diesel_diff_liter, gasoline_closing_liter, diesel_closing_liter, gasoline_day_adj_liter, diesel_day_adj_liter, gas_stock_in_inserted, gas_sale_inserted, diesel_stock_in_inserted, diesel_sale_inserted) VALUES
(#{r.batchId}, #{r.rowNo}, #{r.saleDate}, #{r.gasolineInLiter}, #{r.gasolineSaleLiter}, #{r.gasolineDiffLiter}, #{r.gasolineSellingPrice}, #{r.gasolineBuyPrice}, #{r.dieselInLiter}, #{r.dieselSaleLiter}, #{r.dieselDiffLiter}, #{r.dieselSellingPrice}, #{r.dieselBuyPrice}, #{r.adjGasolinePhysicalLiter}, #{r.adjGasolineDiffLiter}, #{r.adjDieselPhysicalLiter}, #{r.adjDieselDiffLiter}, #{r.gasolineClosingLiter}, #{r.dieselClosingLiter}, #{r.gasolineDayAdjLiter}, #{r.dieselDayAdjLiter}, #{r.gasStockInInserted}, #{r.gasSaleInserted}, #{r.dieselStockInInserted}, #{r.dieselSaleInserted})
mapper.select: SELECT batch_id, file_name, total_rows, inserted_count, applied_date_count, uploaded_at FROM tb_excel_upload_batch ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC, batch_id DESC

SELECT row_id, batch_id, row_no, sale_date, gasoline_in_liter, gasoline_sale_liter, gasoline_diff_liter, gasoline_selling_price, gasoline_buy_price, diesel_in_liter, diesel_sale_liter, diesel_diff_liter, diesel_selling_price, diesel_buy_price, adj_gasoline_physical_liter, adj_gasoline_diff_liter, adj_diesel_physical_liter, adj_diesel_diff_liter, gasoline_closing_liter, diesel_closing_liter, gasoline_day_adj_liter, diesel_day_adj_liter, gas_stock_in_inserted, gas_sale_inserted, diesel_stock_in_inserted, diesel_sale_inserted FROM tb_excel_upload_row WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY row_no ASC
